audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 to 4 read Graves / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath while the prose under them says level 1 is a wash, level 2-3 is Graves' takeover window, and levels 4-5 are 'close enough to call skill'. The mirrored Cho'Gath audit and the packet both read Skill / Graves / Graves / Skill.
audit.why: The sides were shifted one row out of step with their own reasons, and both the mirror and the packet agree with the reasons.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill (5/10), Level 2 Graves (7/10), Level 3 Graves (7/10), Levels 4-5 Skill (5/10). Rows 5-7 left alone — see questionsForUser.
sources: brief currentText content whys[0] through whys[3]

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you six separate times to commit 'on Rupture's cooldown' without ever saying what it is.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6s at every rank. Waiting it out buys you six seconds — so the advice as written is close to useless. What actually beats it is the ground telegraph. Feral Scream is 11s at rank 1 and Feast is 80s.
audit.corrected: Rupture is 6s — you beat it by sidestepping the telegraph, not by counting it down. The cooldown worth tracking is Feral Scream (11s at rank 1), because its silence is what locks Quickdraw.
sources: _kits/chogath.json Q cd 6, W cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, R cd 80/70/60

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves' E is called 'Bushwhack' in three places. Smoke Screen is called a blind twice.
audit.why: Graves' E is Quickdraw. Graves' W reduces sight range and briefly slows on impact — it does not blind, so it was never what broke his Feral Scream follow-up.
audit.corrected: Quickdraw is the dash, and Feral Scream's silence is what denies it — that pairing is the real interaction. Smoke Screen slows and cuts his sight, which is enough to break the follow-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence was mentioned only in passing as something that 'bites if you overstay'.
audit.why: Silence denies ability casts, which against Graves means Quickdraw is off — the escape from a point-blank trade disappears. That is the single most punishing thing in the lane and it is on 11s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream silences you for the duration, so Quickdraw is unavailable — never step in while his W is up unless you can leave on foot.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: Both of you are slow at level 1 — one ability each and no Quickdraw yet, so neither side commits.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Quickdraw (E, 16s at rank 1) online — dash to point-blank, dump the spread, leave before his Rupture lands.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Rupture is a 6s cooldown but heavily telegraphed — sidestep it and Cho has no follow-up.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Rupture (Knockup); your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: His whole all-in is Rupture into Feral Scream (11s at rank 1), and that silence locks Quickdraw — sidestep the first and it dies.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Feast is 80s at 175 range and pure true damage — at full HP it can't finish you, but Collateral Damage can finish him.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Feast-stacked HP plus flat true damage ignores every point True Grit stacked — the duel is his now.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture (Knockup): matchup-defining — Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all. Check it before every step-up. - E dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath Rupture (6s at rank 1): matchup-defining — the cooldown is short, so beat it by sidestepping the ground telegraph, not by waiting it out. - E dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath’s Rupture (Knockup): Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Rupture (Q, 6s at rank 1): it returns fast, so beat the ground telegraph by sidestepping — waiting out six seconds buys nothing.

edits.before: Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Telegraphed knockup on a 6s cooldown — sidestep it, because waiting it out is only six seconds of safety.

edits.before: Full Q-E-W online, you dash in, blast the spread, then W-blind or Bushwhack out before his delayed Q-Rupture knockup resolves.
edits.after: Full kit online: dash in, blast the spread, then Quickdraw out before his telegraphed Rupture knockup resolves.

edits.before: Your Eclipse/Youmuu's tempo spike outpaces his early tank items — keep forcing all-ins before Feast stacks pile up.
edits.after: His first armor item blanks physical shells — resists and Feast stacks arrive faster than your Eclipse tempo does.

edits.before: With E-Quickdraw plus Q-End of the Line online you can dash to point-blank, dump the 4-shell spread, and back out on a Bushwhack charge before Cho can land a delayed Rupture.
edits.after: With Quickdraw (E, 16s at rank 1) plus End of the Line online you can dash to point-blank, dump the 4-shell spread, and back out before Cho lands his telegraphed Rupture.

edits.before: Sidestep the delayed Q-Rupture knockup, then W-Smoke Screen his face to blind the follow-up and break his W-Feral Scream all-in
edits.after: Sidestep the telegraphed Rupture, then Smoke Screen his face — the slow and sight cut break his Feral Scream follow-up

edits.before: Land the delayed Q-Rupture knockup into W-Feral Scream silence to lock down your Quickdraw escape
edits.after: Land the telegraphed Rupture into Feral Scream (11s at rank 1) — the silence turns Quickdraw off entirely

edits.before: Cho is a slow, immobile Level 1 — but so are you with one ability and no Quickdraw charge yet, so the first window is a wash: last-hit at range and don't walk up into a free Q-Rupture. Your takeover starts at 2-3. Once you have E-Quickdraw plus Q-End of the Line, dash in, dump the 4-shell point-blank spread, and Bushwhack back out before his Rupture resolves. The one thing to respect is that Rupture — it has a long ground-telegraph delay; sidestep it and Cho has no follow-up burst, and his W-Feral Scream silence only bites if you've overstayed on top of him.
edits.after: Cho is a slow, immobile Level 1 — but so are you with one ability and no Quickdraw yet, so the first window is a wash: last-hit at range and don't walk up into a free Rupture. Your takeover starts at 2-3. Once you have Quickdraw (16s at rank 1) plus End of the Line, dash in, dump the 4-shell point-blank spread, and leave before his Rupture resolves. Rupture is only a 6s cooldown, so you beat it by reading the ground telegraph, not by counting — and never step in while Feral Scream is up, because its silence turns Quickdraw off.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your stacked True Grit armor/MR and refreshing Quickdraw charges win every extended trade a pre-tank Cho can muster — his entire all-in is Q-Rupture into W-Feral Scream, so sidestep the knockup and the combo is dead. At 6 you spike harder than he does: Collateral Damage adds a shell nuke on top of your Q + spread, and because Feast only true-damage executes targets that are already low, you can burst him down in a window where he physically can't ult you back. Force the all-in whenever his Rupture is on cooldown.
edits.after: Through 4-5 your stacked True Grit armor and MR — refreshed every time you land an auto — win the extended trades a pre-tank Cho can muster. His entire all-in is Rupture into Feral Scream (11s at rank 1), so sidestep the knockup and the silence never lands. At 6 you spike harder: Collateral Damage adds a shell nuke on top of your Q and spread, while Feast is 80s of flat true damage at 175 range that can't finish a healthy target. Force the all-in while his Feral Scream is down, not merely his Rupture.

notes: 'Bushwhack' appears three times for Graves' E — his E is Quickdraw; corrected. The mirrored Cho'Gath audit already found 'Buckshot' used as a Graves ability name across that entry, and this page carries the same habit in breakdown.early ('bully with buckshot') — that string is champion-generic boilerplate shared across many Graves entries, so I left it rather than fix it in one place only; worth a global sweep. Biggest substantive gain: the page repeatedly says to commit 'on Rupture's cooldown' when Rupture is a flat 6 seconds — the useful cooldown is Feral Scream at 11s, whose silence is what actually denies Quickdraw. Level chart rows 1-4 flipped as one group to match the mirror and the packet; rows 5-7 left untouched and raised as a question.
